note: ATAPI reads (PIO and DMA) of sector data return success with no data on both the PS2 DVD and a PS3 control disc: the drive/hypervisor most likely withholds media data until the disc authentication is done (the secure service softemu calls). Next: how to reach that service from the netemu partition.

stages.name: Patch / install / test pipeline and durable HDD log
Netemu partition talks to the drive (open, DMA map, ATAPI commands)
Disc authentication (likely required for any data read)
Level 2: emulator disc layer reads from the drive (boot)
Level 4: usable (app, stub ISO, configs, no-disc messages)
